guide.text: Boosts the entire squad's Attack, helping Batman and his allies seize the early AoE advantage. Best suited for lineups focused on wiping out groups of enemies.
Increases all allies' Attack at the start of battle. Scarecrow grants a bonus to allies at the start of battle, and with the Gabriel Horn, he can quickly secure an advantage for the squad.
Hawkgirl needs to stay on the front line and keep up the pressure, and this weapon helps improve the entire squad's combat effectiveness.
Grants a large HP bonus to improve damage sharing. The Energy Gain Bonus enables faster Ultimate usage to counter enemy burst, while also providing Attack bonuses to allies.
Grants a massive HP increase and Energy Gain Bonus, while also boosting allies' Attack. Enhances survivability while providing bonuses to allies.
Increases Attack and Crit Rate, helping Batman crit more often and hit harder. It also makes better use of his Legacy Piece's crit-based damage reduction and bombing runs.
Increases HP and grants a squadwide Attack bonus, boosting Supergirl Woman of Tomorrow's healing and transformed damage while increasing the squad's overall damage.
Boosts HP and strengthens the entire squad's offense.
Boosts crit-based damage and helps Robin keep his skills flowing, making it ideal for single-target bursts during [Afterimage].
